# LUI Apple Backend

This directory contains the pure SwiftUI Apple backend from
`tiensonqin/lui` revision `e40875424519253a548951a0fd3d5acf71af4a9e`.

Android uses the separately versioned `lui_flutter_backend` dependency in
`Flutter/pubspec.yaml`. The Apple source is vendored so the Swift package does
not include Android transpilation plugins or generated Kotlin targets.
